_note: Template selection guide for the lower-level visual rendering step. Pick based on signal type. Read the chosen template HTML, write a filled version directly to <run>/whiteboard.html. The lower-third byline MUST come from config/author.json.
_templates_dir_note: Templates are bundled inside the skill folder. Resolve <SKILL_ROOT> to wherever the skill lives (typically ~/.claude/skills/databricks-pulse).

templates.vibe: Big hero number, comparison row, gradient bg
TV news broadcast, red BREAKING bar, ticker, lower-third byline
Cyan/magenta neon, Orbitron font, scanlines, sci-fi
use_when: Mosaic AI / Foundation Models / agentic stack
Anything DatabricksIQ / Genie / Agent Bricks adjacent
Long-form piece referenced as a 'paper of record' item

selection_rules: If multiple templates fit, pick the one used LEAST RECENTLY — track in state/template_history.json or check published.json. Variety beats theoretical fit.
GA launches default to 03_breaking_news but use 09_futuristic if topic is AI-agent specific.
Customer stories with concrete metrics → 02_stat_card. Without metrics → 10_newspaper.
When in doubt, the breaking_news template is the safe default — it's the only one with a battle-tested fill recipe in render-images.mjs.
